svg.aria-label: Left: after k gradient steps each eigen-direction has reached a fraction of its least-squares value that closely follows the ridge filter with alpha equal to 1 over eta k. Right: on a five-feature regression, the weights along the gradient-descent path (solid) roughly track the ridge solutions with alpha equal to 1 over eta k (dashed)
